faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting the CSJMU Programmer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Chhatrapati Shahu Ji Maharaj University, Kanpur (CSJMU), located in Uttar Pradesh, for filling non-teaching positions under the education sector.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under CSJMU Programmer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the post of Programmer under this recruitment notification released by Chhatrapati Shahu Ji Maharaj University, Kanpur.

faq.question: Q3. What are the important dates for submitting the online application?
faq.answer: The online application process begins on 26 September 2026 and closes on 31 October 2026. Hard copies must also be submitted by the specified deadline.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the Programmer post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.Tech/B.E., M.C.A., M.Sc. in Computer Science or a Second Class Bachelor degree with a 'B' level DOE course certificate, plus 2 years of software development experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for General and OBC candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for General, OBC, and EWS category candidates is Rs. 2000/-, while SC and ST candidates are required to pay Rs. 1500/-.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for CSJMU Programmer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises a basic academic score evaluation, followed by a proficiency test and a personal interview conducted by the university.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for the CSJMU Programmer position?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online through the official website www.csjmu.ac.in, pay the fee, upload necessary documents, and send the printed hard copy via post.

faq.question: Q8. Where should the hard copy of the application form be sent?
faq.answer: The hard copy of the application along with supporting documents should be sent to The Registrar, Chhatrapati Shahu Ji Maharaj University, Kalyanpur, Kanpur – 208024 (U.P.).

faq.question: Q9. What is the age limit for the CSJMU Programmer position?
faq.answer: The age limit and relaxations are applicable strictly as per the U.P. Government norms. Candidates should check official rules for specific details.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website of CSJMU to check updates?
faq.answer: Candidates can visit the official website at www.csjmu.ac.in to access notifications, submit online applications, and check further recruitment updates.
